title: 第3章 徒弟放心，为师给你把风
novel_title: 宗门收徒，我能看见属性词条
content_zh:
当李应灵从这深山老林里，灰头土脸的走回破庙时已经是正午。

    粉红色的流仙裙上也全是泥巴，脸上都有几道泥土痕迹。

    手中的木棍也换成了一只野兔。

    原本目标的确是野鸡，但野鸡都站树上，哪里那么好抓。

    只好抓住一只可怜的兔兔，虽然心有不忍。

    兔兔的确很可爱，但肚肚更可怜不是吗？

    推开破庙的门。

    李应灵目光看去，自己的便宜师父烧着热水。

    楚星尘看向灰头土脸的李应灵，叹气询问道：

    “让你出去打个野，怎么看上去被野打了？”

    李应灵闻言差点没气过头去，本想大声反驳。

    但想起那本水心经确实厉害无比。

    面前的师父或许真是高人呢？

    也许只是在磨练自己呢？

    她只能弱弱反驳道：“哪有那么好抓。”

    楚星尘走过去，接过李应灵手中的兔子，捏起它的耳朵瞧了瞧。

    “太瘦了，下次抓肥一点的，肥一点烤起来好吃。”

    “哦……”

    看了眼李应灵受气包一般的神情，楚星尘自信道：

    “不用露出这副表情，等为师给你露一手，下次你出去打野的时候就又有动力了。”

    李应灵露出疑惑的神色，随后她就看见楚星尘掏出了一把匕首。

    十分熟练的展示了如何处理一只可爱的兔子。

    随后用五行术法唤来一团水，将它冲洗干净。

    要说游离走遍玄武国有什么好处。

    那自然是香料调料一样不缺，统统放进了空间戒指中。

    由于戒指里没有流动，还有非常不错的保鲜效果。

    拿出大蒜葱香，先给她做一道爆辣兔头！

    左边身子红烧，右边身子蒜香！

    很快，兔子做成的三盘菜端上了桌。

    色香味俱全！

    楚星尘将那一盘兔头推到李应灵身前：

    “这是你第一次打野，这最绝的兔头让给你了。”

    看着可爱的兔兔变成好香的兔兔。

    不争气的眼泪从嘴巴里流了出来。

    但对于兔头，李应灵本能还是有些拒绝的。

    毕竟作为一个年轻富有同情心的少女，吃兔兔的肉肉已经是极限了。
content_en:
It was already noon when Li Yingling walked back to the ruined temple in disgrace from the deep mountains and old forests.

    The pink fairy skirt was also covered in mud, and there were a few traces of mud on her face.

    The wooden stick in his hand was also replaced by a hare.

    The original target was indeed pheasants, but pheasants were all standing on trees, so they were not easy to catch.

    I had to catch a poor rabbit, although I couldn't bear it.

    The rabbit is indeed cute, but the belly is even more pitiful, isn't it?

    Push open the door of the ruined temple.

    Li Yingling looked around and saw his cheap master heating hot water.

    Chu Xingchen looked at the disgraced Li Yingling, sighed and asked:

    "I asked you to go out to fight in the wild. Why do you look like you were beaten by the wild?"

    Li Yingling almost lost his temper when he heard this and wanted to refute loudly.

    But when I think of the Water Heart Sutra, it is really powerful.

    Maybe the master in front of me is really an expert?

    Maybe you're just training yourself?

    She could only retort weakly: "It's not that easy to catch."

    Chu Xingchen walked over, took the rabbit from Li Yingling's hand, pinched its ears and took a look.

    "It's too thin. Next time I'll grab a fatter one. It will taste better when grilled."

    "Oh..."

    After looking at Li Yingling's angry expression, Chu Xingchen said confidently:

    "You don't have to show this expression. Once I show you my skills, you will be motivated again next time you go out to play in the wild."

    Li Yingling looked confused, and then she saw Chu Xingchen take out a dagger.

    Very skillfully demonstrated how to handle a cute bunny.

    Then he used the Five Elements Technique to summon a ball of water and rinse it clean.

    What are the benefits of wandering around Xuanwu Country?

    Of course, there is no shortage of spices and seasonings, and they are all put into the space ring.

    Since there is no flow in the ring, it also has a very good preservation effect.

    Take out the garlic and onion and make her a spicy rabbit head first!

    The left side is braised and the right side is garlicky!

    Soon, three plates of rabbit dishes were served.

    Full of color and flavor!

    Chu Xingchen pushed the plate of rabbit heads in front of Li Yingling:

    "This is your first time playing in the wild, and I give you the most amazing rabbit head."

    Watch the cute bunny turn into a sweet-smelling bunny.

    Tears of disappointment flowed from his mouth.

    But Li Yingling instinctively rejected the rabbit head.

    After all, as a young and compassionate girl, eating rabbit meat is already the limit.
title_en: Chapter 3 Disciple, don’t worry, I will be your master’s guard
